name: ce.registers
description: Read general and optional XMM registers through Windows debugger source guards. Native stopped truth is refreshed; stopGeneration must match the current native waiting context. Reject processSuspended and any debug_getContext result other than literal true. Old register snapshots do not establish the context's continued lifetime; recheck for each operation. These source guards do not imply every architecture or call variant is proven. Status and detach cleanup remain available.

expectedStopGeneration.description: Must match the current stopGeneration and native waiting context. Reject processSuspended and debug_getContext results other than literal true; an old snapshot does not establish continued context lifetime.
